summary: Genome sequence for the horse, ass, plains/Grevy's/mountain zebras and kiang is public (53 NCBI assemblies; 57,487 SRA records for Equus) and Open Tree provides names and a topology scaffold. No open dataset codes coat/stripe state per equid species or pairs it with the tree; the only phenotype table found covers zebras and its columns were not read. Ancient quagga reads and a TBX3 allele alignment were not located as ready tables.
next_step: Compile a species-by-coat-state table (striped, partly striped, unstriped, dun markings) from the literature and align it to a genome-based tree built from the NCBI assemblies; identify the ancient quagga and TBX3 (Imsland et al.) accessions in SRA/ENA.
obstacles_confirmed: No repository dataset with equid coat-pattern coding was found.
MorphoBank returned 403 to automated requests, so fossil character matrices could not be checked.
